crossRefs.note: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat…
Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out…
Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes, and sprang into the multitude, crying…
They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry…
“Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night on the ground.
The children of Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening; and they asked of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I again…
Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh…
The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.
They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
translations.bsb: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening, as did the elders of Israel; and they all sprinkled dust on their heads.
translations.kjv: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.
translations.asv: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of Jehovah until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust upon their heads.
